value.rationale: Quadrisecant lines are a canonical enumerative invariant of space curves. The theorem converts a high-degree Cayley expression into a sharp, finite mod-8 phase law for an infinite geometric family and yields a concrete real-existence certificate on exactly 3/8 of bidegree residue classes. The classification is global in both degrees and separates the expected finite regime from lower-degree excess phenomena, rather than reporting isolated computations.
